name: affido web-search gold dataset
provenance: Queries and URLs were chosen after a discovery pass against the live operator stack (SearXNG JSON endpoint and Camofox /tabs+/evaluate). Relevance labels and content markers were written before any scored attempt. Markers come from an independent host-side fetch of each URL (curl + HTML text extraction), not from the affido web_read output. Raw discovery outputs are kept in runs/<run-id>/pre-gold/. Version 2 dropped the lang field: language=en selects a different SearXNG engine set and makes the target URLs unstable; the scored run uses the node's default engine set, the same one the faux /prompt path uses. Version 3 keeps the frozen queries, URLs and markers unchanged but documents the new response envelopes, structuredOutput, requestId, diagnostics and head+focus reading window. A new scored run with a new run id and date is required; the 20261105T100715Z numbers are historical.
tool_contract: POST /search returns {requestId, results:[{sourceId, title, domain, snippet}], diagnostics}; the model sees only results, which contain NO URL. POST /read returns {requestId, page:{untrusted,url,title,text,sha256,truncated,totalChars}, diagnostics}. A specific URL cannot be passed to /read. The harness selects up to 3 results whose domain matches the gold URL's domain, reads their opaque ids, and compares the URL revealed in page.url with the gold URL. url_reach_rate measures that resolution, not a URL lookup.

scoring.relevance: A result is relevant when its domain ends with one of relevance.domains, or when title+snippet+domain contain at least 2 of relevance.topical_terms. A result is irrelevant first when its URL/title/snippet matches exclude_url_regex, or when its domain ends with one of exclude_domains. Matching is case-insensitive; domain matching is suffix-based.
scoring.markers: A marker is present when the whitespace-collapsed, lowercase delivered text contains the whitespace-collapsed, lowercase marker. head_markers are expected inside the first 6000 characters of the page's visible text; deep_markers are expected after it (verified at freeze time against Camofox full innerText). The node may select a head+focus window, so a deep marker can appear in the delivered 6000 characters without the whole page being delivered.
scoring.normalization: URLs match when lowercase scheme + hostname without leading www. + pathname without trailing slash are equal; query strings and fragments are ignored. http and https are NOT interchangeable.
